Behind the glamorous facade of a “tourist paradise” and a thriving financial hub, the reality is that ordinary workers don’t really benefit from it.
And I understand your point of view. There are many dark realities that only those who live and work there can truly understand. However, for tourists, it’s still a wonderful place to visit and experience.
